description: Kept the book, named no line-count, and left the column empty.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Held the other favour, and did not stoop.
name: Arthur Meeks

description: Left the cuckoo song for tomorrow and sent Nick to the top of the part.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Held the glove, stood the shorter, and was not in the watchet.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Worked the wrong mask, and took the rhyme out of the hangings.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Waited at the post for the Worthies, shield in hand.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Asked for another pass at remuneration and was told to say what is set down.
name: Will Kemp

description: Set the space, refused the gown for today, and sent the rhyme outward.
name: William Shakespeare
